lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor thirty-four. A hundred and fifty-eight megawatts. Be advised there is a Sable Reach crew on the deck and they are not shooting at anybody.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Say again?

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Eleven of them. They have been overrun. Their lift is forty minutes out.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Mortar emplacement's cleared, for what it's worth. Thirty megawatts, reaches most of this board, and it cannot see air at all.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Control, are we ordered to hold for their evacuation?

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: You are not ordered to.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Understood. Okonkwo, put the mortar where it covers their side of the ring.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Contact. Warden pattern, and a lot of it.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Their crew chief is on our channel. He says thank you, and he says he can hold a breaker if we tell him which one.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Tell him the north relay. And tell him if he touches anything else I'll know.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Field lead, be advised: Actual is asking why your losses are on a Sable Reach position.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Because that's where the wardens are, Control.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: We're down four. Ruiz, Adeyemi, and two of theirs I don't have names for.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Get the names.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Their lift's on the pad. Nine of eleven walking.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Over capacity — and their people are standing in the arc. Whatever you shed, not the north side.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: One through. Their crew is behind that line.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Hold. Forty minutes was the number and we're at thirty-one.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor held. Sable Reach personnel evacuated: nine. Meridian losses: four.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Ruiz, Adeyemi, Sandoval, Kerr. Say them properly, Control.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Ruiz. Adeyemi. Sandoval. Kerr.
lines.beat: Control does exactly as asked and nothing more — the tone does not change, which is the point

lines.speaker: ferrar
lines.text: Captain. I did not ask you to do that.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: No. You didn't.
